preset.not.label: Lecture notes
preset.not.text: This is a transcript of a lecture. Fix spelling and punctuation, correct misheard terms based on context, and remove filler words (um, uh, like). Add headings by topic. Don't change the meaning or add information.
preset.duzelt.label: Fix only
preset.duzelt.text: Only fix spelling, punctuation and misheard words. Don't touch the sentence structure or order.
preset.ozet.label: Summary
preset.ozet.text: Write a short bullet-point summary of the lecture's main ideas.

st.vadDesc: Skips silent parts so the model doesn't make up sentences.
st.languageDesc: Setting the language gives more accurate results than auto-detect.
st.aiDesc: Paste a key and press Test. If it works, it's saved and its models are listed. Keys are stored in the macOS Keychain.
